title: Skater and Critic
body:
We have $$	ext{skate\_record},$$ a DataFrame where each row describes a skating performance with the following columns:
• $$	ext{critic\_1}:$$ Critic 1's rating on the performance. (type $$=$$ numpy.int64)
• $$	ext{critic\_2}:$$ Critic 2's rating on the performance. (type $$=$$ numpy.int64)
• comment: An audience comment on that performance. (type $$=$$ str)
• $$	ext{self\_rating}:$$ The skater's self-rating on the performance. (type $$=$$ numpy.int64)
All ratings are between $$0$$ to $$100$$ inclusive.
